provenance.denoise_note: RealESRGAN_x4plus declares no denoise_pair, so _denoise_for drops any value and no denoising stage runs. Denoise is structurally absent rather than held constant.
provenance.output_format: png (lossless); metrics from the array, size and hash from the encode
provenance.neural_pass: run once per photograph and cached; every arm sharpens that same array

sharpening_semantics.channel: correction computed on Rec.709 luma and added equally to R, G and B
sharpening_semantics.zero: strength 0 returns the caller's array unchanged - a true no-op
